user_prompt: Determine the maximum mass m which may be applied to the truss without exceeding 30.0 kN in tension or 50.0 kN in compression in any member.Identify the maximum allowable mass, the critical member that governs this limit, and whether that member is in tension or compression.

controlling_member.description: The ID of the member that reaches its limit first (e.g., 'AB').

controlling_state.description: The failure mode of the controlling member.
